title: 第5章 周岁宴第6章 抓周
slug: 大千世界今日吾逍遥也
content_zh:
要说朔衡的周岁宴，那确实是极尽奢华。
其原因，共有三点。
首先，朔衡的亲爹乃是当今朔家的现任家主，其子的满月宴，自然不能草草了事。
其次，因为朔衡的天赋，在朔家地位顶尖的那一小撮人里已经不是什么秘密。
九祖认可的圣灵根天赋者，天生风雷之体。
朔衡降生当日的天地异象，整个朔家方圆千万里之内的人都可谓是有目共睹。
最后，也是最让人意外的一点。
梵阳界中，“三宫六家九殿”，乃是立于整片大陆最顶尖的十八个大势力。
其中，朔家赫然在列。
但真论实力，朔家也只属于一个不上不下的位置。
或许有一些藏拙的因素在里面，但说到底，哪家能把全部实力都摆在明面上呢？肯定都是要暗地里留一手的。
所以论整体实力，朔家在这十八个顶尖势力之中，算不上强。
而朔家能在数个纪元的更新换代中屹立至今的原因，大抵与他们广结善缘的家族宗旨颇有关系。
世代经营着整个梵阳界最大的商行之一，拥有遍布整片大陆的拍卖场和商会。
商人逐利，四处结缘，才有如今朔家的稳固地位。
而与朔家关系最好的势力之一，便是苍澜仙宫——在听说了朔衡的天赋后更是有了明确的收徒想法。
要知道，那可是苍澜仙宫啊！
单说明面上的实力，两个朔家加起来也不是一个苍澜仙宫的对手。
要不是因为当年九祖朔古跟苍澜仙宫的现任宫主有过一段不菲的交情，估计都搭不上人家的顺风车。
那可是真正屹立在梵阳界顶端的存在。

能与其掰手腕的势力，绝不超过一手之数。
所以这次朔衡的周岁宴大办特办，也是因为苍澜仙宫派了人前来观礼的缘由。
于是朔涯一合计，干脆广发请帖，邀请跟朔家交情不浅的势力都来做客。
一来，显摆显摆他朔家的麒麟子。
二来，也是为着苍澜仙宫的缘故，把消息散出去。
——让他们知道朔家是有靠山在的。
原本就关系亲近，现在家主之子要成为人家的亲传弟子，可不就是亲上加亲？
当然，若是最后苍澜仙宫并未真的收朔衡为徒，那朔家也没什么损失。
明面上，就是邀请一些关系好的势力来吃饭喝酒罢了。
——
周岁宴当天。
朔衡被晏情抱在怀里，仔仔细细的套上了一件紫色长袍。
虽然小，做工却极精细。
天蚕丝为底，刀枪不入。
其上还用金缕线勾勒着青竹纹样，看起来高贵雅致。
content_en:
Speaking of Shuo Heng's first birthday party, it was indeed extremely luxurious.
There are three reasons for this.
First of all, Shuo Heng's biological father is the current head of the Shuo family, so his son's full moon banquet cannot be taken lightly.
Secondly, because of Shuo Heng's talent, it is no secret among the small group of people at the top of the Shuo family.
Those with the Holy Spirit root recognized by the Nine Ancestors are born with a body of wind and thunder.
The vision of heaven and earth on the day Shuo Heng was born was witnessed by everyone within tens of millions of miles of the entire Shuo family.
Finally, and the most surprising point.
In the Fanyang Realm, the "Three Palaces, Six Families and Nine Palaces" are the eighteen major forces that stand at the top of the entire continent.
Among them, the Shuo family is prominently listed.
But in terms of true strength, the Shuo family only belongs to a position that is neither above nor below.
There may be some hidden clumsy factors in it, but in the final analysis, which company can put all its strength on the surface? They definitely have to keep something secret.
Therefore, in terms of overall strength, the Shuo family is not considered strong among the eighteen top forces.
The reason why the Shuo family has been able to survive through the changes of several eras is probably related to their family purpose of forming good relationships.
For generations, he has been running one of the largest trading houses in the entire Fanyang world, with auction houses and chambers of commerce all over the continent.
Businessmen pursue profits and make connections everywhere, which is why the Shuo family has a stable position today.
One of the forces that has the best relationship with the Shuo family is Canglan Immortal Palace - after hearing about Shuo Heng's talent, they had a clear idea of ​​recruiting disciples.
You know, that is Canglan Immortal Palace!
Just looking at their superficial strength, the two Shuo families combined are no match for Canglan Immortal Palace.
If it hadn't been for the fact that the Ninth Patriarch Shuo Gu had a rich friendship with the current palace owner of Canglan Immortal Palace, he probably wouldn't have been able to ride on his coattails.
That is the existence that truly stands at the top of the Brahma Yang Realm.
The number of forces that can compete with it will never exceed one hand.
So this time Shuo Heng's first birthday banquet was held in a special way because Canglan Immortal Palace sent people to watch the ceremony.
So Shuo Ya made a plan and simply sent out invitations widely, inviting those who had close friendship with the Shuo family to come as guests.
First, he showed off his Qilin son of the Shuo family.
Secondly, it was also for the sake of Canglan Immortal Palace to spread the news.
——Let them know that the Shuo family has a backer.
They were already close to each other, but now that the son of the head of the family wants to become his direct disciple, isn't it just like getting closer to him?
Of course, if Canglan Immortal Palace did not really accept Shuo Heng as its disciple in the end, then the Shuo family would have nothing to lose.
On the surface, it's just inviting some well-connected forces to have dinner and drinks.
——
The day of the birthday party.
Shuo Heng was held in Yan Qing's arms and carefully put on a purple robe.
Although small, the workmanship is extremely fine.
The base is silk, making it invulnerable.
There is also a green bamboo pattern outlined with gold thread, which looks noble and elegant.
